## llm

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `llm.activeTextProvider` | `string` | `unset` | Id of the `providers` entry that answers chat turns. |
| `llm.activeEmbeddingProvider` | `string` | `unset` | Id of the `providers` entry that computes embeddings for memory recall. |
| `llm.toolTransport` | `'auto' \| 'grammar' \| 'native_tools'` | `unset` | How tool calls reach the model: `grammar` (a constrained-output grammar), `native_tools` (the provider's tool-calling API), or `auto` to pick per provider. |
| `llm.providers` | `UserLlmProviderEntry[]` | `unset` | The configured model providers (local llama-server, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, subscription CLIs), each with an `id`, `kind` and connection settings. The provider screens in the TUI and the desktop app write it. |
| `llm.providers[].privacy.shield` | `'off' \| 'auto' \| 'on'` | `unset` | Privacy Shield routing for OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic providers. The default auto follows the global switch and skips local-looking endpoints. On forces protection for gateways that forward to the cloud. Off bypasses protection. Managed llama-server and subscription-cli ignore this setting. |
| `llm.fallback.chain` | `string[]` | `unset` | Provider ids to fall over to, in order, when the active provider keeps failing. |
| `llm.fallback.appendLocal` | `boolean` | `unset` | Also append the local llama-server provider to the end of the chain. Default `false`: a cloud error is shown rather than silently moving to a local model. |
| `llm.fallback.failureThreshold` | `number` | `unset` | Consecutive failures before the chain moves on (errors that mean the provider is down move at once). Default `3`. |
| `llm.fallback.cooldownMs` | `number[]` | `unset` | Escalating cooldowns of a failed provider, in ms; the last entry is the cap. Default `[30000, 60000, 300000]`. |
| `llm.fallback.probeThrottleMs` | `number` | `unset` | Shortest gap between two probes of the primary while on a fallback, in ms. Default `300000`. |
| `llm.fallback.failureWindowMs` | `number` | `unset` | A provider with no error for this long starts its failure count afresh, in ms. Default `86400000` (one day). |
| `llm.runMode.mode` | `RunModeName` | `unset` | How a chat runs: `local` (everything on this machine), `cloud` (everything on the active cloud provider) or `fusion` (a cloud model orchestrates local-model workers). `llm.activeTextProvider` stays authoritative. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.orchestratorProvider` | `string` | `unset` | The orchestrator leg. Must name a configured provider whose kind is NOT `llama-server`. Default: the active provider when it is a cloud one, else the first cloud provider in `llm.providers`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.orchestratorModel` | `string` | `unset` | Informational pin for the orchestrator model. The wire request carries no model field — the provider entry's `defaultChatModel` is what actually serves — so this only overrides what is *displayed* and priced. Left unset by the TUI. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workerProvider` | `string` | `unset` | The worker leg. Must name a configured `llama-server` provider. Default: the first `llama-server` provider in `llm.providers`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workerModel` | `string` | `unset` | Informational pin for the worker model. The managed daemon serves whatever `localModels.managed.modelId` names; this only overrides the label. Left unset by the TUI. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workers` | `number` | `unset` | Default fan-out width, 1..8. Default 2 on a cloud worker leg; on a local (slot-affine) leg an unset value means one worker at a time, and only a value written here raises that (`workersPinned`). |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.cloudWorkers` | `number` | `unset` | Ceiling on the fan-out width when the workers run on a cloud leg, 1..32. Default 4. A local leg is bounded by its request slots; a cloud leg has no such limit, only a bill, so an over-ambitious `maxWorkers` is clamped here and the result says so. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workerReasoning` | `FusionWorkerReasoning` | `unset` | Reasoning effort sent with every worker completion, mapped per provider family (OpenRouter `reasoning.effort`, OpenAI-compatible `reasoning_effort`). Unset by default: the provider's own default. A run spent 87 % of its worker output on hidden reasoning and 41K tokens deciding to read a file; this is the knob for that. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.orchestratorReasoning` | `FusionOrchestratorReasoning` | `unset` | Reasoning effort of the orchestrator's own completions in a fusion turn (not the workers', not ordinary turns). Unset by default: the provider's default (Fable 5.2+ on the native Anthropic kind: medium). A turn's explicit effort still wins; a person's level beats both. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workerMaxOutputTokens` | `number` | `unset` | Per-step output cap for worker completions, in tokens. Unset by default (the model's maximum). Keep it above the largest single write a worker makes (~10K tokens) or it re-creates the 8192 wall. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workerMaxSteps` | `number` | `unset` | Step ceiling per worker turn. Default 60 (`DEFAULT_FUSION_WORKER_MAX_STEPS`). |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.workerTimeoutMs` | `number` | `unset` | Wall-clock ceiling per worker turn, in ms. Default 2 700 000, 45 min (`DEFAULT_FUSION_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS`). |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.reviewStallSteps` | `number` | `unset` | How many consecutive read-only orchestrator steps without a `fusion.delegate` count as a stalled review (F41). At N the model is told once to delegate or reply; at 2N the step admits only `fusion.delegate`, `reply` and `finish`. Halved (rounded up) when the turn's message reads as a repair request. `0` disables both. Default 6. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.turnBudgetUsd` | `number` | `unset` | Spend cap for one fusion turn, in USD (ATO-947): the orchestrator's own priced completions plus every worker's, counted with the prompt cache discount. Once reached, the turn starts no new delegation and no new worker, and the orchestrator is told to say so plainly. Unset or `0`: no cap, as before. Unpriced (local) tokens count as $0. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.turnTimeBudgetMs` | `number` | `unset` | Wall-clock cap for one fusion turn, in ms, measured from the turn's start (ATO-947). Same effect as `turnBudgetUsd` when reached. Unset or `0`: no cap. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.maxRoundsPerTurn` | `number` | `unset` | Most delegations (`fusion.delegate` calls, "rounds") one fusion turn may start (ATO-1406). Counted rather than priced, because a subscription leg's limit is requests, not dollars. Unset: the default (`DEFAULT_FUSION_MAX_ROUNDS_PER_TURN`); `0`: no cap. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.maxTasksPerTurn` | `number` | `unset` | Most worker tasks one fusion turn may start across its delegations (ATO-1406). Unset: `DEFAULT_FUSION_MAX_TASKS_PER_TURN`; `0`: no cap. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.maxOrchestratorTasksPerTurn` | `number` | `unset` | Most tasks one fusion turn may send to `model: "orchestrator"` (a worker turn on the orchestrator leg). Counted rather than priced, because that leg is often a subscription whose turns have no price to cap. Unset: `DEFAULT_FUSION_MAX_ORCHESTRATOR_TASKS_PER_TURN`; `0` turns the target off (unlike the caps above, where `0` lifts the cap). |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.escalation` | `FusionEscalationMode` | `unset` | Automatic escalation of a stuck worker (ATO-942). `"advisor"`: when a worker stalls (same result 3x, read-only for 6 steps) or its first answer is cut by its time limit, the escalation model reads a compressed trace of that node and sends the worker a short hint; the worker carries on. At most one automatic escalation per worker. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.escalationReplace` | `boolean` | `unset` | Behind a flag, default `false`: a worker that stays stuck after its advisor hint is stopped and its task re-run on the escalation model with what was found so far. Needs a priced escalation model, so the per-escalation cap can be enforced. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.escalationProvider` | `string` | `unset` | The model escalations go to. Must name a configured provider that is not the worker leg. Default: the orchestrator leg. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.escalationMaxUsd` | `number` | `unset` | Spend cap for one escalation, in USD. Default 0.25. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.judge` | `'off' \| 'on'` | `unset` | The trimmed judge (ATO-944). `"on"`: every task gets an acceptance checklist in its brief, built from the contract (checks, provides, declared files) plus its deliverable; after the work, failed facts and a fresh-context judge decide whether the task closes. A red list re-runs the task once, then is reported as failed. Default `"off"`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.judgeProvider` | `string` | `unset` | The judge's model: a configured provider. Default: the orchestrator leg. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.autoReplan` | `number` | `unset` | Automatic replanning (ATO-941): how many times one task may be sent back to the planner after it did not close (failed, judged red, handed back, out of steps or time). |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.roles` | `Partial<Record<FusionRole, string>>` | `unset` | Models by role (ATO-943): each names a configured provider, the same shape as `escalationProvider`. A provider entry serves one model, so a role's model IS its provider entry (two cloud models = two entries). |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.mixLocalModels` | `boolean` | `unset` | This machine can serve a second local model next to the session's own (ATO-943). Without it, a role whose provider is another llama-server entry is not used while the session already holds a local model: its tasks run on the worker leg and the row says so. Default `false`. Cloud role models never need it. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.outcomeLog` | `boolean` | `unset` | The outcome log (`<stateDir>/fusion/outcomes.ndjson`): one line of counts and categories per worker task and per fusion turn, read by `atomic-agent fusion report`. No prompt, reply or path is written. Default `true`; `false` writes nothing. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.measuredRouting.enabled` | `boolean` | `unset` | Pick the model of an unpinned task from recent task-check outcomes. Default `false`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.measuredRouting.minSamples` | `number` | `unset` | Outcomes a candidate needs before it can be picked, 3 to 1000. Default `8`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.measuredRouting.days` | `number` | `unset` | How many days of outcomes count, 1 to 365. Default `30`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.localFormatCheck` | `boolean` | `unset` | The one-call format check before the first fan-out on a local worker leg: a few dozen tokens under the workers' own grammar, and a reply that does not parse refuses the fan-out before a worker spends its time. Default `true`; `false` sends workers unchecked, as before. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.outcomeJournal` | `boolean` | `unset` | The outcome journal (ATO-949): every finished worker task leaves a row of counts and labels in `<stateDir>/fusion-outcomes.jsonl`, and the planner's `### fusion` block states what past runs showed. Default `true`; `false` writes no rows and states no summary. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.isolation` | `FusionIsolationMode` | `unset` | Branch isolation (ATO-946). `"worktree"`: every task of a fan-out works in a workspace of its own (a detached git worktree inside a git repo, a folder copy elsewhere); after its wave the changes are merged back into the working directory file by file with a three-way merge, a conflicting file is left as it was and handed to the planner as a merge task, and a… |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.integration` | `'direct' \| 'candidate'` | `unset` | Whole-fanout verified file promotion; direct (default) keeps existing integration behavior. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.taskTree.enabled` | `boolean` | `unset` | Default `false`: the tree is flat, as before. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.taskTree.maxDepth` | `number` | `unset` | How deep the tree may grow, counting the orchestrator's own tasks as depth 1. Default 2 (one level of split); hard-capped at 3. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.taskTree.maxNodes` | `number` | `unset` | Every node of one fan-out, the orchestrator's tasks included. Default 24. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.directors` | `string[]` | `unset` | Models that may direct a fusion session (plan, delegate, reply), as `"<providerId>:<model>"`. At least one; each provider id must name a configured provider. The director is chosen per session; `orchestratorProvider` names the default one. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.workers` | `string[]` | `unset` | Models that may run a delegated task, as `"<providerId>:<model>"`. A task's worker must be one of these. `workerProvider` names the default when it is a member; otherwise the first reachable one. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.reviewers` | `string[]` | `unset` | Models that may review a finished task, as `"<providerId>:<model>"`. Listing any turns per-task review on unless `review` is `"off"` (issue #38). No fitting reviewer for a task: `judgeProvider` reviews it when `judge` is on, else no model does. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.crossFamilyReview` | `boolean` | `unset` | Among reviewers no weaker than the worker (by the model tier table; a local model is below any cloud one), prefer one whose family (Anthropic, OpenAI, local, other) differs from the worker's. A stronger reviewer of the worker's own family still comes before an equal one of another. `false`: config order within each strength. Default `true`. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.review` | `'off' \| 'on'` | `unset` | Per-task review by a reviewer (issue #38). Unset: on when `reviewers` lists any, else `judge` decides as before. `"on"` or `"off"` set it explicitly, whatever `judge` says. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.reviewPasses` | `0 \| 1 \| 2` | `unset` | How many extra passes a task gets when its review asks for changes, within the turn's budget: 0, 1 or 2. Default 2. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.watchEveryMinutes` | `number` | `unset` | How often, in minutes, a running task of a team run is checked for progress (issue #43): 0 to 60, 0 turns the watch off. A task's own `watchMinutes` in `fusion.delegate` wins. Default 5. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.watchMaxChecks` | `number` | `unset` | At most this many judge calls per watched task when its progress is unclear, across all its runs (review passes and an escalation re-run), counted against the turn's budget: 1 to 10. Default 3. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.planReviewer` | `string` | `unset` | The model that reviews a project plan before the plan gate reaches the person (issue #118), as `"<providerId>:<model>"`. Unset: the first of `reviewers`; neither: no plan review. In a folder whose `projects.constraints` restrict providers, only a member the policy allows reviews the plan; with none, the review is skipped and the gate says so. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.team.planReviewRounds` | `number` | `unset` | How many times a plan the plan reviewer fails goes back to the director before the gate reaches the person with the open notes: 0 to 3. Default 2. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.project.fullPlanAboveTasks` | `number` | `unset` | Show the full plan when it has more tasks than this, 0 to 1000. Default 4. |
| `llm.runMode.fusion.project.fullPlanAboveUsd` | `number` | `unset` | Show the full plan when its estimated cost is above this many US dollars, 0 to 10000. Default 1. |
| `llm.openrouter.preferCacheRoutes` | `boolean` | `unset` | Steer models whose caching depends on the route toward the routes that cache — today `google/…` models to Google AI Studio, which cached 83 % of input where Vertex cached 1–4 % — unless the entry configured `providerPreferences` of its own. |
| `llm.costTracking.enabled` | `boolean` | `unset` | Track the cost of cloud calls. Default `false`. |
| `llm.costTracking.showInStatusBar` | `boolean` | `unset` | Add today's spend, all sessions together, to the composer readout (ATO-649): `$0.31 · today $1.20`. The session's own cost is shown either way (ATO-569). |
| `llm.costTracking.dailyResetHourUtc` | `number` | `unset` | UTC hour (0-23) the spend day starts at, for `dailyLimitUsd` and the day total: the day is the UTC calendar day shifted to start at this hour. Default 0 (UTC midnight). |
| `llm.costTracking.dailyLimitUsd` | `number` | `unset` | Daily spend ceiling in USD, all sessions together (ATO-649). |
| `llm.costTracking.onDailyLimit` | `'local' \| 'stop'` | `unset` | What happens once today's spend reaches `dailyLimitUsd` (ATO-649): `"stop"` (default) pauses cloud calls and says so in the chat; `"local"` moves the turn on to the local model when the fallback chain has one. |
| `llm.router.enabled` | `boolean` | `unset` | Turn the rule-based model router on. Off unless this is `true` and `rules` has at least one rule. |
| `llm.router.rules` | `UserLlmRouterRule[]` | `unset` | Router rules, first match wins: conditions on the request (size, image, words, working folder, …) and the provider a matching turn goes to. |

## Environment variables

Read from the process environment or from `~/.atomic-agent/.env` (a variable already set in the environment wins over the file). "Overrides" names the config key a variable wins over; the rest exist only as environment variables. `atomic-agent config env` prints this table.

| Variable | Default | Overrides | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_STATE_DIR` | `"~/.atomic-agent"` | env only | State directory: config.json, .env, sessions, memory, models and traces. Shared by the terminal agent and the desktop app. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_GRAMMARS_DIR` | unset | env only | Folder with the tool-call grammars. Unset: the copy shipped next to the binary. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TOOL_CALL_GRAMMAR` | unset | env only | Path of the tool-call grammar file (tool-call.gbnf) to use instead of the one found next to the binary. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_STARTER_SKILLS_DIR` | unset | env only | Folder the starter skills are copied from on first run. Unset: the starter-skills folder shipped with the app. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TREE_SITTER_DIR` | unset | env only | Folder with tree-sitter grammars; when set and loadable, the code map parses with tree-sitter on top of its regex outline. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_AST_GREP_PATH` | unset | env only | Path of the ast-grep binary os.code.search and os.code.rewrite run. Unset: ast-grep found on PATH. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR` | unset | env only | Folder of skills shared by every agent, read with the lowest priority. Unset: ~/.agents/skills. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_MAX_TOKENS` | unset | `localModels.completionMaxTokens` | Cap on tokens one local-model reply may produce, 64 to 131072. Wins over the config value when set. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` | unset | `localModels.requestTimeoutMs` | Budget of one local-model request (the idle gap for a stream), in ms. Wins over the config value when set. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SKILLS_CATALOG_BUDGET` | unset | `skills.catalogTokenBudget` | Token budget of the skills list in the prompt, 1 to 100000. Wins over the config value when set. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_URL` | unset | `browser.cdpUrl` | Attach the browser tools to an already running Chrome at this DevTools URL. Wins over the config value when set. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_DOWNLOAD_CONNECTIONS` | unset | `localModels.download.connections` | Parallel connections of one model download, for this shell only. Wins over the config value when set. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_API_KEY` | unset | env only | API key sent to the local model server. Unset: the managed server's own key, or none. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS` | `3000` | env only | Timeout of one health check of the local model server, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS` | `1800000` | env only | How long a local stream may wait for its first token, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_STREAM_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS` | `21600000` | env only | Backstop on one whole streaming reply from a local model, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_HEALTH_RETRIES` | `5` | env only | Health-check attempts before the local model server counts as down. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_HEALTH_BACKOFF_MS` | `500` | env only | Pause between health-check attempts, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_COMPLETION_RETRIES` | `3` | env only | Retries of a failed local completion request. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_COMPLETION_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS` | `150` | env only | Pause between local completion retries, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_DEFAULT_SLOT` | `0` | env only | llama.cpp slot id used for the chat. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_TEMPERATURE` | `0.2` | env only | Sampling temperature sent to the local model server when the request sets none (evals pin it). A per-request value still wins. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_TOP_P` | `0.95` | env only | Top-p sent to the local model server when the request sets none. A per-request value still wins. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_TOP_K` | `40` | env only | Top-k sent to the local model server when the request sets none. A per-request value still wins. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LLAMA_SEED` | unset | env only | Sampling seed sent to the local model server, for reproducible runs. Unset: no seed. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_STABLE_PREFIX_SALT` | `"atomic-agent-v1"` | env only | Salt of the prompt-prefix hash. Changing it invalidates cached prompt prefixes. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOADED_TOOLS_CAP` | `8` | env only | How many rarely used tool schemas a session keeps loaded, 1 to 64. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOADED_TOOLS_MAX_TOKENS` | `600` | env only | Token cap of the loaded-tools prompt section, 0 to 8000. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_AUTO_EXPAND_RARE_ON_ERROR` | `true` | env only | Attach a rare tool's full schema after the tool fails. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS` | `8` | env only | Soft cap on tool calls in one step, 1 to 16. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BATCH_TOOL_RESULT_CHAR_CAP` | `32000` | env only | Cap on the combined characters of all tool results in one step. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SHELL_TOOL_RESULT_CHAR_CAP` | `16000` | env only | Cap on the characters of one shell command result the model sees. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SHELL_TOOL_RESULT_TAIL_LINES` | `500` | env only | How many last lines of a shell command result the model sees. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOOP_WARNING_THRESHOLD` | `3` | env only | Repeats of the same call before the model is told it is not making progress. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOOP_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD` | `5` | env only | Identical call-and-result streak that blocks the next identical call. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOOP_BREAKER_VETO_STREAK` | `3` | env only | Blocked calls in a row before the agent is made to reply instead. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOOP_HISTORY_SIZE` | `30` | env only | How many recent calls the loop detector remembers. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOOP_WANDERING_THRESHOLD` | `6` | env only | Calls with varied arguments to one tool before the model is redirected. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_LOOP_WANDERING_ESCALATION` | `12` | env only | Calls with varied arguments to one tool before the agent is made to reply. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_REPLY_POLISH` | `true` | env only | Clean up the final reply before a chat surface shows it. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SKILL_CURATOR` | `false` | env only | Run the skill curator on its own, at most once a week. `atomic-agent skill curate` runs it by hand either way. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_JUDGE_URL` | unset | env only | OpenAI-compatible endpoint that judges `skill eval` runs (or --judge-url). Unset: a configured provider judges. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_JUDGE_MODEL` | unset | env only | Model the ATOMIC_AGENT_JUDGE_URL judge runs (or --judge-model). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_JUDGE_API_KEY` | unset | env only | API key sent to the ATOMIC_AGENT_JUDGE_URL judge. Unset: OPENROUTER_API_KEY. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS` | `60000` | env only | Per-call timeout of the skill eval judge, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SANDBOX` | `"off"` | env only | Set to workspace to run the agent's shell and verification commands in the OS sandbox: writes only in the working folder and temporary folders, no reads of credential folders or the state directory. Where no sandbox exists (Windows, Linux without bwrap) commands are refused. Unset or any other value: off. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SANDBOX_ALLOW_ROOT` | `"0"` | env only | Set to 1 only with operator consent to allow Linux Safe Mode under host UID 0. Prefer an ordinary user. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SANDBOX_NETWORK` | `"off"` | env only | Set to on to permit one-time shell network requests. Each command also needs network: true, explicit approval and an unrestricted egress policy. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SANDBOX_TOOLCHAINS` | unset | env only | Additional absolute read-only toolchain directories for Safe Mode, separated like PATH. Entire private roots and their ancestors stay hidden. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_ENABLED` | `true` | env only | Register the browser tools. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_CHANNEL` | `"chrome"` | env only | Browser to launch: chrome, msedge or chromium. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_HEADLESS` | `false` | env only | Run the agent's browser without a window. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH` | unset | env only | Path of the browser binary to launch instead of the channel's default. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX` | `false` | env only | Launch the browser without its sandbox (some containers need this). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_BROWSER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT_MS` | `30000` | env only | How long to wait for the browser to start, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_ENABLED` | `true` | env only | Background task queue. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `3` | env only | Attempts before a failing task is marked failed. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_BACKOFF_INITIAL_MS` | `1000` | env only | First retry delay of a failed task, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_BACKOFF_MAX_MS` | `60000` | env only | Longest retry delay of a failed task, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_RUN_ON_CREATE` | `true` | env only | Start a task as soon as it is created. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_STALE_AFTER_MS` | `300000` | env only | A running task with no progress for this long is put back in the queue, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_SCHEDULER_ENABLED` | `true` | env only | Scheduler that wakes up timed and repeating tasks. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_SCHEDULER_TICK_MS` | `5000` | env only | Scheduler polling interval, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_SCHEDULER_BATCH` | `10` | env only | Most due tasks started per scheduler tick. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_AGENT_TOOLS_ENABLED` | `true` | env only | Let the agent schedule, list and cancel tasks itself. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS` | `1000` | env only | Shortest allowed interval of a repeating task, in ms. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_REPORT_QUIET_HOURS` | unset | env only | Hold task reports in this local-time window and send one digest after it, e.g. 23:00-08:00. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_STATUS_SNAPSHOT_EVERY_STEPS` | `10` | env only | Post a status snapshot of a long run every this many steps; 0 turns it off. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_STATUS_SNAPSHOT_EVERY_MS` | `300000` | env only | Post a status snapshot of a long run this often, in ms; 0 turns it off. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SESSION_TOOLS_ENABLED` | `false` | env only | Let the agent list, read and message its other sessions (the sessions.* tools). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TASKS_KEEP_AWAKE` | unset | env only | Keep the computer awake for tasks and turns: off or while-working. Unset or any other value: off. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TUI_SKIP_LLAMA_SETUP` | unset | env only | Set to 1 to skip the first-run setup screen (same as --skip-llama-setup). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TERMINAL` | unset | env only | Terminal emulator the TUI opens a new window in on Linux. Unset: $TERMINAL, then the first known terminal found. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_CONHOST_GUARD` | unset | env only | 1 forces, 0 disables the fallbacks for the legacy Windows console. Unset: detected. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_NO_SYNC_OUTPUT` | unset | env only | Set to 1 to stop the TUI from wrapping frames in synchronized-output markers (for terminals that mishandle them). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_PERSONA` | unset | env only | Persona name to use for this process, above every config.json setting. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_OFFLINE` | unset | env only | Set to 1 (or true, yes, on) to turn offline mode on for this process whatever network.offline says; it cannot turn it off. Not saved. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | unset | env only | Comma-separated web origins for the unauthenticated HTTP test harness, besides loopback ones. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_MEMORY_GUARD` | unset | env only | Set to 0 to turn off `serve`'s memory guard, which shuts the server down cleanly when its heap nears the limit (for a heap raised on purpose). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_SERVE_NO_PARENT_EXIT` | unset | env only | Set to 1 to keep `serve` running after the process that started it exits (same as --no-parent-exit). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_RUN_RSS_LIMIT_MB` | unset | env only | Memory cap, in MB of resident memory, past which the exit watchdog of `run` ends the process. Unset: 4096. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_RUN_MEMORY_TRACE` | unset | env only | File `run` appends a memory trace to (NDJSON: phases, heap and rss every second from the main thread and from a worker thread). Unset: no trace. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_MODEL_CATALOG_URL` | unset | env only | URL of the extra local-model catalog JSON. Unset: the catalog hosted on atomicagent.io. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_TELEGRAM_STREAM_REPLIES` | unset | env only | Stream Telegram replies into the owner's DM (private) or not (off). Wins over telegram.streamReplies when set. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_WHISPER_BIN` | unset | env only | Path of the whisper.cpp CLI for audio transcription. Unset: the downloaded copy, then the PATH. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_WHISPER_MODEL` | unset | env only | Whisper model file or catalog id to transcribe with. Unset: the saved default (base). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_FFMPEG_BIN` | unset | env only | Path of ffmpeg, used to convert audio before transcription. Unset: the PATH. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_INLINE_IMAGES` | unset | env only | Set to 1 to show images inline in the terminal (kitty and iTerm2 graphics). |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_NO_INLINE_IMAGES` | unset | env only | Set to 1 to never show inline images in the terminal; wins over ATOMIC_AGENT_INLINE_IMAGES. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_UPDATE_CHECK_ON_STARTUP` | `true` | env only | Check GitHub Releases for a newer version when the TUI starts. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_REPO` | `"AtomicBot-ai/atomic-agent"` | env only | GitHub owner/repo used for update checks and self-update. |
| `ATOMIC_AGENT_ANALYTICS` | unset | env only | Set to off to turn anonymous analytics and crash reports off for this process, whatever analytics.enabled says. Not saved. |
| `DO_NOT_TRACK` | unset | env only | Set to 1 to turn analytics and crash reports off, the same as ATOMIC_AGENT_ANALYTICS=off. |

Provider API keys (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and the rest) are also read from the environment or `.env`; the provider settings in the TUI and the desktop app write them for you.
